voice.name: Sulafat
voice.style: Clear, natural English for an adult airport listening lesson. Warm and conversational, with distinct questions and answers. Use a natural learning pace and light emphasis on the information a traveler must confirm. Do not sing, spell ordinary words, or add any words.

youtube.title: Finding a restroom and asking about forms | Airport English Day 38
youtube.description:
You cannot find the restroom or the address field on a form; how can you ask for directions?

Practice asking where a facility or form field is, and listen for when it is safe to move.

Fictional airport conversations for listening practice. Numbers, airline names and locations are examples, not current travel instructions. Confirm actual arrangements with your airport and airline.

sources.title: Cabin safety | UK Civil Aviation Authority
Turbulence: Staying Safe | Federal Aviation Administration
JAL | In case of Sudden Turbulence
Visit the UK as a Standard Visitor: Overview - GOV.UK
